blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-grained visual reasoning is essential for remote sensing in urban management, yet remains underexplored in the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UMBench, a fine-grained urban remote sensing benchmark built from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for multiple urban management tasks such as traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. Evaluations on UMBench reveal that current MLLMs often rely on scene-level priors and overlook fine-grained visual evidence. To address this issue, we further propose a novel evidence-first chain-of-thought method that directs models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence in a training-free manner. Experiments show that our method can improve the performance of both open-source and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.
blocks.zh: 精细的视觉推理对于遥感在城市管理中至关重要,但在评价多式联运大语言模型时仍然没有得到充分利用。 我们提出UM Bench,这是利用无人驾驶航空飞行器(UAV)图像构建的精细的城市遥感基准,用于交通监测、城市建设、环境质量和灾害警报等多重城市管理任务。 对UM Bench的评价显示,目前的MLLMs经常依赖场景级别前身,忽略了精细的视觉证据. 为了解决这一问题,我们进一步提出一种新的证据第一链式思维方法,指导模型以无培训方式检查精细的视觉证据。 实验显示,我们的方法可以提高UMBench上的开源和商用MLLMs的性能.

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Remote sensing (RS) has become an important information source for urban management, supporting a range of applications, including urban sustainability monitoring, disaster risk management, and observation of diverse urban environments [ 7 , 4 , 3 ] . In these applications, effective image understanding should not stop at scene-level recognition, but should support task-specific reasoning based on fine-grained visual evidence [ 6 , 9 ] . Since such reasoning tasks are often task-dependent and difficult to cover with a fixed set of predefined labels, MLLMs offer a flexible interface for interpreting RS images through natural-language queries and linking fine-grained visual evidence to task-specific reasoning. However, fine-grained visual reasoning in urban management remains underexplored in MLLM evaluation.
blocks.zh: 遥感已成为城市管理的重要信息来源,支持一系列应用,包括城市可持续性监测、灾害风险管理、以及观测不同的城市环境[7、4、3]。 在这些应用中,有效的图像理解不应止于场景层面的识别,而应支持基于细纹视觉证据的特定任务推理[6,9]. 由于这种推理任务往往依赖于任务,难以用一组固定的预定义标签来覆盖,MLLM为通过自然语言查询来解释RS图像提供了灵活的界面,并将细纹视觉证据与任务特定推理联系起来. 然而,城市管理中精细的视觉推理在MLLM评价中仍然没有得到充分利用.

blocks.en: Existing RS evaluation benchmarks primarily focus on scene-level visual capabilities [ 10 ] . However, models may rely on scene-level priors, inferring answers from overall scene context or common object co-occurrence rather than from fine-grained visual evidence, a failure mode related to object hallucination in vision-language models [ 11 ] . For example, scene-level questions may ask whether an image contains a road, while fine-grained questions ask whether a vehicle crosses a lane line or whether local cracks exist. Traditional datasets, such as RSVQA [ 13 ] , mainly evaluate scene classification or generic question answering, where many answers can be inferred from scene-level information without explicitly testing fine-grained visual evidence. Even high-resolution benchmarks, such as FloodNet [ 15 ] , primarily evaluate scene classification or generic question answering, focusing on scene-level understanding or binary classification. Existing evaluations rarely test the intersection of fine-grained visual inspection and logical reasoning. In real-world RS applications, targets can be minute, ambiguous, and embedded in complex backgrounds. Current evaluations do not test whether an MLLM discerns these fine-grained visual details or guesses from scene-level priors.
blocks.zh: 现有的RS评价基准主要侧重于现场视觉能力[10]. 然而,模型可能依赖于场景级别前传,推断出来自整体场景背景或常见物体共同发生的答案,而不是来自精细的视觉证据,一种与视觉语言模型中的物体幻觉相关的故障模式[11]. 例如,场景层的问题可能会问一幅图像是否包含一条道路,而细纹问题则会问一辆车是否跨越一条车道线,或者是否存在局部裂缝. 传统的数据集,如RSVQA [13],主要评价场景分类或泛题回答,从场景级信息中可以推断出许多答案,而没有明确测试精细的视觉证据. 甚至高分辨率基准,如FloodNet[15],主要评价场景分类或通用问答,侧重于场景层面的理解或二进制分类. 现有的评价很少测试精细的视觉检查和逻辑推理的交叉点. 在现实世界的RS应用中,目标可以是分钟,模棱两可,并嵌入复杂的背景. 目前的评价并不测试MLLM是否从场景层面的前身中发现了这些细微的视觉细节或猜测.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce UMBench, an Urban Management Benchmark for fine-grained visual reasoning in complex RS scenarios. It is built from 583 UAV images and contains 2,733 expert-curated QA pairs spanning traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. UMBench tests whether models can combine fine-grained visual inspection with reasoning instead of relying on scene-level priors.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了UM Bench,这是在复杂的塞族共和国情景中进行精细视觉推理的城市管理基准。 它由583幅无人驾驶航空器图像建造,包含2 733对经过专家验证的QA配对,涵盖交通监测、城市建设、环境质量和灾害警报。 UM Bench测试模型是否能够将精细的视觉检查与推理相结合,而不是依赖场景级别的前身.

blocks.en: To reduce reliance on scene-level priors, we propose a training-free evidence-first chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting method [ 17 ] . The method guides models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence before making a final choice. Since it requires no model fine-tuning or access to model weights, it can be applied to both open-source MLLMs and commercial MLLMs. Experiments on representative Qwen-VL, InternVL, and commercial models show that the proposed method improves performance across different access settings.
blocks.zh: 为了减少对场景前科的依赖,我们提议采用无培训证据-第一思考链(COT)激励方法[17]. 该方法指导模型在做出最终选择前检查精细的视觉证据. 由于不需要模型微调或访问模型权重,它既可以应用于开源MLLM,也可以应用于商业MLLM. 对具有代表性的Quen-VL,InternVL,以及商业模型的实验表明,拟议方法改善了不同访问环境的性能.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows. • We propose UMBench, the first urban remote sensing benchmark for fine-grained visual reasoning in urban management. • We design a novel training-free method to guide MLLMs to focus on fine-grained visual evidence rather than scene-level priors. • The designed method is applicable to both open-source and commercial MLLMs due to its training-free property.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下。 我们提出UM Bench,这是城市管理中第一个精细视觉推理的城市遥感基准。 我们设计了一种新的无训练方法,指导MLLMs注重精细的视觉证据,而不是场景层面的前身. ^ 由于其无培训财产,设计的方法适用于开源和商业的MLLM。

blocks.en: We propose UMBench, the first urban remote sensing benchmark for fine-grained visual reasoning in urban management.
blocks.zh: 我们提出UM Bench,这是城市管理中第一个精细视觉推理的城市遥感基准.

blocks.en: We design a novel training-free method to guide MLLMs to focus on fine-grained visual evidence rather than scene-level priors.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一种新颖的无训练方法来引导MLLMs专注于精细的视觉证据,而不是场景层面的前身.

blocks.en: The designed method is applicable to both open-source and commercial MLLMs due to its training-free property.
blocks.zh: 由于其无培训财产,设计的方法适用于开源和商业的MLLM。

blocks.en: II UMBENCH DATASET
blocks.zh: 二. 铀数据

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of UMBench. Red boxes are manually added for visualization only and are not provided to models during evaluation. Each example illustrates a compact multiple-choice question that requires fine-grained visual reasoning rather than scene-level priors.
blocks.zh: 图1:UM Bench概览. 红箱只为可视化而手工添加,评价期间不提供给模型. 每个例子都说明了一个紧凑的多重选择问题,需要精细的视觉推理而不是场景层面的前身.

blocks.en: In this work, fine-grained visual reasoning denotes questions that cannot be solved from a global scene category alone. A correct answer must be supported by fine-grained evidence, including small-object inspection, attribute judgment, spatial-relation reasoning, or explicit verification against a plausible scene-level prior. This distinction is important for urban management because visually similar scenes may encode different operational states, such as lawful traffic versus lane crossing, intact pavement versus local cracking, or normal water surfaces versus inundation.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,精细的视觉推理是指无法单独从全球场景类别中解决的问题. 正确的答案必须有精细证据作为佐证,包括小对象检查、属性判断、空间关系推理,或针对一个可能存在的场景级别前进行明确核查。 这种区分对城市管理很重要,因为视觉上相似的场景可能编码不同的运行状态,例如合法交通与过道,完整人行道与局部裂缝,或正常的水面与淹水。

blocks.en: UMBench comprises 583 UAV images covering urban environments, complementing large-scale RS vision-language resources [ 20 , 12 ] . The processed images are stored in PNG format, with the longer side resized to 800 pixels while preserving aspect ratio; GSD metadata was not available from the processed files. The image pool includes intersections, parking lots, residential blocks, construction zones, rivers, parks, green spaces, and open fields. Rather than treating high pixel resolution as the primary contribution, UMBench emphasizes task-relevant evidence such as vehicles, lane markings, barriers, pavement texture, water surfaces, vegetation patterns, and object relations. Blurred, overexposed, ambiguous, and near-duplicate images were removed during quality control.
blocks.zh: UM Bench 包含: 583幅覆盖城市环境的无人驾驶航空器图像,补充了大规模的RS视觉语言资源[20,12]. 已处理的图像以PNG格式存储,较长的侧面缩放为800像素,同时保留侧面比;没有从已处理的文件获取GSD元数据. 影像池包括交叉路口,停车场,住宅区,建筑区,河流,公园,绿色空间,以及露天田园. UMBench没有将高像素分辨率视为主要贡献,而是强调与任务相关的证据,如车辆、车道标志、障碍物、人行道纹理、水面、植被模式和物体关系。 在质量控制期间,模糊、过度曝光、模棱两可和几乎重复的图像被移除。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the benchmark organizes 2,733 QA pairs into four application groups: Traffic Monitoring evaluates vehicle behavior, congestion, parking use, and lane relations; Urban Construction examines buildings, roads, and construction conditions; Environmental Quality covers water, vegetation, waste, and air-quality evidence; and Disaster Warning targets inundation, collapse, fire, obstruction, and infrastructure risks. A QA pair may receive multiple application tags, yielding 3,305 cumulative tag assignments (TM/UC/EQ/DW: 1,129/755/992/429).
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,基准将2 733对质量保证分为四个应用组: 交通监测评估车辆行为、拥堵、停车使用和车道关系; 城市建设审查建筑物、道路和建筑条件; 环境质量涵盖水、植被、废物和空气质量证据; 灾害警报目标淹没、倒塌、火灾、障碍和基础设施风险。 QA配对可能会收到多个应用标记,产生3,305个累积标记任务(TM/UC/EQ/DW:1,129/755/992/429).

blocks.en: Each instance is a multiple-choice question designed to resist answers based on scene-level priors. Annotators first identified a visually verifiable evidence region, formulated a question whose answer depends on that region, and then constructed scene-compatible distractors that differ in fine-grained visual evidence. All QA pairs were manually curated and reviewed by an expert team for visual verifiability, distractor plausibility, and ambiguity. Disagreements were resolved through consensus discussion, and ambiguous cases with unclear evidence or multiple plausible answers were revised or removed. Since labels were finalized through consensus-based expert curation, we report this quality-control protocol rather than an independent inter-annotator agreement score. The complete set is reserved for zero-shot evaluation without task-specific training.
blocks.zh: 每个实例都是一个多选择的问题,旨在基于场景级别前题来抵制答案. 注释者首先确定了一个可视性可核查的证据区域,提出了一个问题,其答案取决于该区域,然后构建了与场景相容的分辨器,在精细的视觉证据上有所不同。 所有 " 质量评估 " 的配对均由一个专家组手动整理和审查,以便进行视觉可核查性、分散注意力和模糊性。 通过协商一致讨论解决了分歧,修改或删除了证据不明确或有多种合理答案的模棱两可的案件。 由于标签是通过以协商一致为基础的专家鉴定最后敲定的,因此我们报告的是这种质量控制协议,而不是独立的通知人之间的协议得分。 完整的套装被保留用于零镜头评价,而不进行具体任务的培训.

blocks.en: III EVIDENCE-FIRST COT METHOD
blocks.zh: 三. 证据-首选方法

blocks.en: As discussed, current MLLMs may rely on scene-level priors when analyzing complex remote sensing imagery, allowing macroscopic context to override fine-grained visual evidence. Inspired by CoT and multimodal reasoning prompts [ 17 , 19 ] , we propose a lightweight, training-free evidence-first Chain-of-Thought prompting method. Instead of asking the model to reason freely, the method imposes an explicit evidence bottleneck: the model must first ground the question in visible local cues, then suppress scene-level priors, and finally map the verified evidence to a constrained option. This ordering is designed for UMBench, where distractors are often semantically plausible at the scene level but inconsistent with small visual details.
blocks.zh: 正如所讨论的那样,在分析复杂的遥感图像时,目前的MLLMs可能依赖于场景级别前科,使宏观上下文能够覆盖精细的视觉证据。 受到CoT和多式联运推理的启发[17,19],我们提出了一种轻量级、无培训证据的第一链式激励方法。 该方法不要求模型自由理性,而是强加了明显的证据瓶颈:模型必须首先将问题打入可见的局部提示,然后压制场景级别前传,最后将已核实的证据映射到一个受限制的选择. 这个订单是为UM Bench设计的,在现场一级,分心器常常是像样的,但与小的视觉细节不一致.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Evidence-first prompting template. The model grounds local cues, suppresses unsupported scene-level priors, and returns a standardized option.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:证据第一提示模板。 模型会根据本地提示,压制不支持的场景级别前缀,并返回一个标准化选项.

blocks.en: This design can be viewed as a compact verify-then-answer framework, as summarized in Fig. 2 . It requires no fine-tuning or access to model weights, and can therefore be applied to both open-source and commercial models. The framework contains three modules. Visual Grounding asks the model to inspect local objects, attributes, and spatial relations before using high-level semantics. Prior Suppression weakens answers supported only by scene type or common co-occurrence patterns. Standardized Output constrains the response to a final option letter, making evaluation robust to verbose outputs.
blocks.zh: 如图2所概述,这种设计可视为一个紧凑的核查和回答框架。 它不需要微调或访问模型权重,因此可以适用于开源模型和商业模型. 该框架包含三个模块。 视觉 地平线要求模型在使用高级语义之前先检查局部物体,属性和空间关系. Prefore Plusion 削弱只有场景类型或常见的共发生模式支持的答案. 标准化产出限制了对最后选项函的回应,使评价变得有力,以动词化产出。

blocks.en: The ordered stages prevent a fluent but unsupported conclusion from bypassing visual verification. Because the image, options, decoding configuration, and model parameters remain unchanged, the method isolates the effect of evidence-oriented prompting without introducing additional supervision or task-specific training.
blocks.zh: 所命令的阶段使一个流畅但无支持的结论无法绕过视觉验证. 由于图像,选项,解码配置和模型参数保持不变,该方法隔离了面向证据的提示效果,而没有引入额外的监督或任务特定训练.

blocks.en: IV EXPERIMENTS AND RESULTS
blocks.zh: 四、警告和结果

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate MLLMs under two complementary access settings. In the local setting , three compact open-source models are deployed under the same preprocessing and inference environment, providing a reproducible test of the method on resource-conscious systems. In the cloud setting , three commercial models are queried without access to their weights, testing whether the same prompt-level intervention transfers to black-box services. All experiments are zero-shot and use identical images, questions, options, and decoding settings across models; only the prompting instruction changes. All models receive the processed PNG images without red-box annotations: local models use their official image processors and default visual-token settings, while commercial models receive the same images through provider APIs. We use fixed decoding settings when available and report exact top-1 accuracy on the full benchmark. Outputs without a valid final option are counted as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个辅助接入设置下评估MLLMs. 在本地设置中,三个紧凑的开源模型被部署在相同的预处理和推论环境中,对资源意识系统的方法提供了一个可复制的测试. 在云层设置中,三款商业模型在无法获得其权重的情况下被问及,测试同样的即时干预是否转移到黑盒服务. 所有实验都是零镜头,使用相同的图像,问题,选项,以及跨模型的解码设置;只有提示指令的改变. 所有模型都接收经过处理的PNG图像,没有红箱说明:本地模型使用其官方图像处理器和默认的可视化脚本设置,而商业模型通过提供者API接收相同的图像. 我们使用固定的解码设置,并在全部基准上报告准确的顶级-1精确度。 没有有效最后选项的产出被算作不正确。

blocks.en: We additionally compare direct answering with standard zero-shot CoT, which appends “Let’s think step by step” to elicit intermediate reasoning [ 8 ] , and our evidence-first CoT. This control distinguishes gains attributable to generic, longer reasoning from those obtained by explicitly grounding the decision in local visual evidence. All three variants use the same samples and require a final option letter for automatic matching.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将直接回答与标准的零镜头 CoT 进行比较, 这种控制区分了可归因于一般性、较长推理的收益和通过将决定明确基于当地视觉证据而获得的收益。 所有三种变体都使用相同的样本,并需要有一个最终选项字母来进行自动匹配.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Representative corrections by evidence-first CoT on Qwen3-VL-8B. Direct answering tends to follow scene-level priors, while our prompt recovers the correct option from fine-grained visual evidence. Red boxes are for visualization only.
blocks.zh: 费格。 3: Quen3-VL-8B上的第一证据委员会的代表性更正。 直接回答往往跟随场景级别前科,而我们迅速从精细的视觉证据中恢复正确的选项. 红盒只用于视觉.

blocks.en: IV-B Main Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-B 主要结果和分析

blocks.en: TABLE I: Results of our method and open-source MLLMs on UMBench.
blocks.zh: 表一:我们的方法和UMBench上的开源MLLMs的结果.

blocks.en: TABLE II: Results of our method and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:我们的方法和UMBench上的商用MLLMs的结果.

blocks.en: Tables I and II summarize the results under two access settings: open-source MLLMs and commercial MLLMs. Table I shows that evidence-first CoT improves the overall accuracy of all three open-source models, with the largest gain observed on InternVL3.5-8B. Table II shows that the same training-free method can also be applied to commercial MLLMs, where Grok-4.20 obtains a clear overall improvement.
blocks.zh: 表一和二汇总了两个访问设置下的结果:开源MLLM和商用MLLM. 图表 我显示证据第一CoT可以提高所有三种开源模型的总体准确性,在InternVL3.5-8B上观察到的最大收益. 表二显示,同样的无培训方法也可适用于商业的MLLMs,Grok-4.20得到了明显的整体改进.

blocks.en: Table III further isolates the effect of prompt structure on the three locally deployed open-source models. ZS-CoT raises InternVL3.5-8B from 42.47 to 44.31 and Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 43.13 to 43.57, whereas evidence-first CoT reaches 46.62 and 44.56, respectively. Thus, unconstrained step-by-step reasoning provides only part of the gain; explicitly verifying visual evidence is more effective overall.
blocks.zh: 表三进一步隔离了即时结构对当地部署的三个开源模型的影响. ZS-CoT将InternVL3.5-8B从42.47提高到44.31,Quen2.5-VL-7B从43.13提高到43.57,而证据第一CoT则分别达到46.62和44.56. 因此,不受约束的逐步推理只能提供部分收益;明确核实视觉证据总体上更为有效.

blocks.en: The direct-answer results show that current MLLMs still struggle with UMBench. Without explicit visual verification, models may select distractors that are consistent with scene-level priors while overlooking the fine-grained visual evidence required by the question. Evidence-first CoT reduces some of these errors by guiding models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence before selecting an option. The qualitative comparisons in Fig. 3 illustrate representative corrections across the four task groups, including congestion assessment, road distress, environmental evidence, and emergency-access obstruction.
blocks.zh: 直接回答的结果显示,目前的MLLMs仍然与UM Bench纠缠不休. 在没有明确的视觉验证的情况下,模型可能选择与场景级别前作一致的分心器,同时俯瞰问题所要求的精细的视觉证据. 证据第一CoT通过指导模型在选择选项之前检查精细的视觉证据来减少其中一些错误. 图3的定性比较说明了四个工作组的有代表性的纠正,包括拥堵评估、道路险阻、环境证据和紧急出入障碍。

blocks.en: Across these cases, evidence-first CoT does not add external knowledge, but redirects the model from scene-level priors to fine-grained visual evidence, such as vehicle density, pavement texture, pollution cues, and access-route continuity. This suggests that the method helps models use visual evidence more effectively, although prompting alone cannot fully solve fine-grained visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在这些案件中,第一证据中心不增加外部知识,而是将模型从场景前期转向精细的视觉证据,例如车辆密度、人行道纹理、污染提示和出入路线连续性。 这表明该方法有助于模型更有效地使用视觉证据,尽管单靠促进并不能完全解决细纹视觉推理.

blocks.en: V CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 五、结 论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce UMBench, a remote sensing Urban Management Benchmark for evaluating fine-grained visual reasoning in MLLMs. UMBench contains 2,733 question-answer pairs across multiple urban management tasks and tests whether models can answer questions based on fine-grained visual evidence rather than scene-level priors. Our evaluations on locally deployed open-source models and cloud-hosted commercial models highlight two findings: 1) current MLLMs still struggle to consistently use fine-grained visual evidence; 2) the proposed evidence-first CoT prompting method improves performance without extra training or access to model weights, although the gains remain model- and task-dependent. Comparisons with ZS-CoT further show the value of explicit visual evidence inspection over generic step-by-step reasoning. These results suggest that future RS-specific MLLMs should strengthen fine-grained visual grounding, small-object perception, and attribute-level reasoning. UMBench provides a focused benchmark for studying fine-grained visual reasoning in urban remote sensing.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了UM Bench,这是一个用于评估MLLMs中精细视觉推理的遥感城市管理基准。 UM Bench包含跨多个城市管理任务的2,733个问答对,并测试模型是否能够根据精细的视觉证据而不是场景层面的前身回答问题. 我们对当地部署的开源模型和云托管的商业模型的评价突出了两个结论: 1) 目前的MLLM仍然在挣扎着持续使用精细的视觉证据;2) 拟议的证据第一CoT提示法在没有额外训练或获得模型权重的情况下提高了性能,尽管收益仍然依赖于模型和任务. 与ZS-COT的比较进一步显示了清晰的视觉证据检查相对于通用的一步步推理的价值. 这些结果表明,未来的塞族共和国特有的MLLMs应当加强精细的视觉定位、小对象感知和属性级推理。 UMBench为研究城市遥感中的精细视觉推理提供了重点基准.
